dedupe_keys.name: promet info hr croatian national access point for traffic data npt

description: promet-info.hr is the Croatian National Access Point, a digital interface where users can access verified and reliable traffic and infrastructure data. The site says the NAP gathers all available information on road and traffic conditions, serving primarily as a data warehouse for accessible traffic data and providing services within the scope of intelligent transport systems, and that for business-to-business exchange it offers services compatible with DATEX II version 2.3. It also refers to the European coordination of national access points and to digitalisation of travel and traffic information in Croatia. Coverage: Croatian roads. Format and access: web interface and DATEX II services. Licence and cost: free to consult; terms not stated on the home page. Caveats: the technical documentation must be requested or read in the service pages. It supports network flow and emergency response studies on Croatian roads. It relates to the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: promet-info.hr: Croatian National Access Point for traffic data (NPT)

sources.note: definition, data warehouse role, DATEX II 2.3
